subject: german
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.explain: 'Der Bahnhof' means 'the train station'; a bus stop is 'die Haltestelle'.
'Das Gepäck' means 'the luggage/baggage'.
'Der Nachbar' means 'the neighbour' (female: 'die Nachbarin').

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Next year I will travel to Austria' (future)?
options: Nächstes Jahr werde ich nach Österreich reisen
Letztes Jahr bin ich nach Österreich gereist
questions.explain: 'Werde... reisen' is the future tense 'will travel'; with 'nächstes Jahr' (next year) the future is correct.
'Sich sonnen' means 'to sunbathe' (from 'die Sonne' = sun).
'Die Sehenswürdigkeiten' means 'the sights/tourist attractions' worth seeing.

questions.q: What does 'gemütlich' mean (e.g. of a room)?
questions.explain: 'Gemuetlich' means 'cosy/comfortable', a typical word for a homely room.
'Sich verlaufen' means 'to get lost' while walking; 'sich verfahren' = to get lost while driving.

questions.q: How do you say 'My house has a large garden'?
options: Mein Haus hat einen kleinen Garten
Mein Haus hat einen großen Garten
Meine Wohnung hat einen großen Garten
questions.explain: 'Einen großen Garten' = 'a large garden'; 'kleinen' (small) is the distractor.
'Die Unterkunft' means 'accommodation'. 'Food' is 'das Essen'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would like to book a double room'?
questions.explain: 'Buchen' = 'to book' and 'ein Doppelzimmer' = 'a double room'; 'Einzelzimmer' (single) and 'absagen' (cancel) are distractors.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'There is no cinema in my village'?
options: In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Kino
In meinem Dorf gibt es ein Kino
In meinem Dorf gibt es kein Kino
questions.explain: 'Das Dorf' = 'village', 'kein Kino' = 'no cinema', 'es gibt' = 'there is'.

questions.q: How do you say 'The hotel was right by the beach'?
options: Das Hotel war direkt am Strand
Das Hotel ist direkt am Strand
Das Hotel war direkt an der Straße
Das Hotel war weit vom Strand
questions.explain: 'War' = 'was', 'direkt am Strand' = 'right by the beach'; 'Straße' (street) is the trap.
'Das Oktoberfest' is the famous folk festival/funfair held in Munich.

questions.q: How do you say 'We are flying to Spain'?
questions.explain: 'Fliegen nach' = 'to fly to' and 'Spanien' = Spain.
'Der Flug' means 'the flight'; 'fliegen' = 'to fly'. ('Der Fluss' = river is the near-miss.)

questions.q: How do you say 'We spent the holidays by the sea'?
options: Wir haben die Ferien in den Bergen verbracht
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht
Wir verbringen die Ferien am Meer
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer gebraucht
questions.explain: 'Am Meer' = 'by the sea' and 'verbracht' (perfect of 'verbringen') = 'spent'; 'gebraucht' (needed) is the trap.
'Die Fahrkarte' is a travel 'ticket'; 'die Landkarte' = map, 'der Führerschein' = driving licence.
'Packen' = 'to pack' and 'die Koffer' = 'the suitcases', so this means 'to pack the suitcases'.

questions.q: How do you say 'The journey lasted three hours'?
options: Die Reise beginnt in drei Stunden
questions.explain: 'Dauern' = 'to last' and 'die Fahrt' = 'the journey/ride'.
'Die Wohnung' means 'the flat/apartment'.
'Das Ausland' means 'abroad/foreign countries'; 'im Ausland' = abroad.
